svg.title: Named proposals in public filings by county, read 11/05/2026
svg.desc: Each square counts the named records in projects.json whose sources name that county, claims pc-001 to pc-044 in data/claims/projects.json, partly verified. Limit: A count of a curated public list on its date: what the filings read say, not every proposal in the region. The county a filing names, not the site; a request or an application is not an approval.
